g.text: PART 4 / 5 · NUTRITION · CALORIE MANAGEMENT — BULK · CUT · REVERSE
THE DAMAGE ISN'T THE DIET. IT'S HOW VIOLENTLY YOU SWITCH. RAMP SLOW — THE TARGET ALREADY MOVED.
the phases are the easy part:
PROMISED maintenance — "reverse lets you eat WAY more"
run it — don't nibble at it
"jump straight back · eat what I want"
add slow · carbs first · stop on the flat · then sit · wk0 2,400 → +75/wk → flatten wk 6–10
THE SWITCH — made or wrecked here
SMOOTH THE NOISE BEFORE YOU MOVE
THE DAY IS NOISE · TWO WEEKS IS SIGNAL
trust two weeks of trend before you react.
HOW FAST YOU MAY CROSS BANDS
few days · nudges calories to hold the rate
the closed loop itself lives in Part 1.0 —
here it just holds the glide.
THE RAMPS ARE MADE OF MACROS
protein hold · fat slight · carbs ↑ (the surplus / the refill)
carbs are the lever you move;
protein & fat are the rails you don't break.
a hard step rings · a rate-limited ramp settles.
IF YOU'RE SO SMART, WHY ARE YOU NOT — HEALTHY · NUTRITION 4.0
MAINTENANCE IS A MOVING TARGET. RAMP SLOW.
